newsitem.title: CANADA: Discovery West plans North Sea expansion.
newsitem.headline: Discovery West plans North Sea expansion.

text.p: Canadian junior oil firm Discovery West Corp said on Thursday it would expand its operations into the U.K. sector of the North Sea in efforts to find larger, high-quality oil reserves.
Discovery West said it planned to buy existing production in mature North Sea fields to generate immediate cash flow and build its business in stages.

"Discovery has had a U.K.-based team of very experienced North Sea Exploration shpecialists in place for almost two years and several acquisition opportunities have been identified and are being pursued," the company said.
The company said it also entered into a joint venture agreement with a major oil company to allow it to participate in a large acquisition.
It said the move was part of Discovery West's reorganization, which would also see non-core assets spun off into a new company.

Its Cold Lake, Alberta oil sands lease and a block of shares in Rayrock Yellowknife Resources were placed in a new entity, BlackRock Ventures. Under the proposal, Discovery shareholders would receive BlackRock shares on a one-to-one basis.
A remaining condition to the move was obtaining a listing for BlackRock on a Canadian stock exchange, the company said.
Discovery West said it expected court approval for the reorganization to be sought in mid-October. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
